title: A companion (Vell) dropped to 3/9 hp fighting the honour guard in the Old Crypts and never recovered before the ending — the final status screen's parenthetical 'a rest at any hearth heals them' only appeared after the game was already over, with no hearth reachable between that fight and the Hollow Throne two rooms later.
where: The Old Crypts / final status screen
